subject: First-party funded bounty versus deliverable, eligible paid work

sources.evidence: Maintainer comment 2026-10-17 20:34:43 UTC confirms funded $5 test, AI-assisted solutions allowed, no active claim at comment time. Claim/delivery requires GitHub sign-in plus Stripe Connect payout onboarding; an existing competing PR #3 was already open. No authenticated eligible payout recipient or exclusive claim verified. Do not attempt work or claim until payout onboarding is legitimately available.

New unclaimed bug report with bounty classification, but reporter appears to be seeking a reward for the report; it is not itself a funded commission to fix. No separate funding independently verified.
Multiple independent implementation PRs already linked by Oct 16; avoid duplicate investment.
Explicitly calls itself zero-bounty $0 until externally funded.

documentary_quality_issue.defect: The script fingerprints URL/decision pairs, so changed candidate URLs yield near-identical negative-outcome episodes even when nothing economically new occurred. Existing ai-commerce-independent-7fc60b1f8451-auto.json and ai-commerce-independent-c52ca7e8a91d-auto.json have the same story with different counts.
documentary_quality_issue.attempted_remedy: In-place guarded dedup patch via GitHub update_file
documentary_quality_issue.proposed_safe_fix: Deduplicate by actual economic outcome/event and limit new episodes to verified material changes; do not repost based only on URL/count differences.

economic_action.reason: No opportunity met funded+accessible payout+deliverable+uncontested+authorized action criteria. No unsolicited outreach, claim, contract or spend.
